analysis_scope: coverage-only; no policy/search regret or outcome association

search_contract.seed_derivation: seed615 NUL opening_id NUL candidate NUL candidate_seat; first 8 SHA-256 bytes big-endian modulo 2^31

replay_and_join_rules.game_population: all registered candidate games from PR #618; skip the registered 12-ply opening prefix as it is not a candidate decision
replay_and_join_rules.transitions: replay each stored absolute move using ordinary deterministic Kalah rules; verify legal ownership, action legality, terminal status, score margin, and winner
replay_and_join_rules.candidate_actor: a post-prefix decision belongs to the candidate iff state.current_player equals that assignment's candidate_seat; opponent decisions are never attributed to B512/S615
replay_and_join_rules.state_identity: SHA-256 of sorted compact ASCII JSON for the replayed player-relative state including current_player; must equal Seed 633 canonical_identity exactly
replay_and_join_rules.source_join: direct exact identity intersection with attempt-0005 metrics and attempt-0003 exact rows; PR #619 policy-prior membership is not required
replay_and_join_rules.occurrences: retain every (game_id, ply) occurrence; unique roots are counted separately; duplicate identity indexes must retain lists and may not overwrite rows
replay_and_join_rules.paired_occurrences: pair B512/S615 only within the same registered opening_id and candidate seat, exact identity, and repeated-occurrence ordinal; no Cartesian pairing

decision_source.mcts: active pit stones > 16, which bypasses the exact-root function and follows registered PUCT path
decision_source.exact_root_solver: active pit stones <= 16 and supported by per-game recorded exact_root_handoff_count plus first_exact_root_handoff_ply replay reconciliation; eligibility alone is insufficient
decision_source.unknown: eligible roots whose exact-root execution cannot be assigned from authenticated per-game handoff telemetry
decision_source.other_registered: count separately if independently evidenced by the frozen execution contract; do not label as MCTS

prohibitions: no model inference, MCTS execution, tablebase probes, solving, games, or training
no action regret or outcome-association calculation
no candidate promotion or execution authorization
no changes to historical evidence or search configuration
